now.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
now.text: Cassandra Nova rules the Void, and Logan and Deadpool first team with her and then fight her. In the end she dies in the Time Ripper.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A Wolverine who first teams with Cassandra, then turns against her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Void's ruler. First Logan's ally, then a foe who dies in the Time Ripper.

proposed.text: Cassandra Nova rules the Void and leaves Logan and Wade to be devoured by Alioth. When Pyro shoots her, Logan talks Wade into saving her, but she then turns on them, and she dies when they destroy the Time Ripper.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Wolverine who attacks Cassandra, then saves her life and helps destroy her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Void's ruler. Logan spares her, and she dies in the Time Ripper.

changes.evidence: Logan and Wade never team with Cassandra: he attacks her at their first meeting and she leaves them for Alioth; during the raid he distracts her so Wade can put on Juggernaut's helmet; after Pyro shoots her, Logan has Wade remove the helmet and she opens a portal, then follows them to use the Time Ripper and is killed when they overload it (Deadpool & Wolverine).

now.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
now.text: Dogpool takes a liking to Logan in the Void and fights alongside him and Deadpool.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A Wolverine Dogpool takes a liking to and fights beside in the Void.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A dog who takes a liking to Logan and fights alongside him.

proposed.text: Dogpool runs up to Logan and Wade in the Void. In Wade's world, Logan holds her up as a shield against the Deadpool variants, who will not shoot her, and later she plays with him at Wade's.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Wolverine who uses Dogpool as a shield, then plays with her at Wade's.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A dog Logan uses as a shield against the Deadpool variants.

changes.evidence: Dogpool never fights alongside Logan; she wanders up to Wade and Logan outside the diner in the Void, and in the Earth-10005 fight Logan uses her as a shield because the Deadpool Corps refuse to harm her; at Wade's dinner she plays with Logan and Laura (Deadpool & Wolverine).

now.title: Doctor Strange
now.text: Lucian Aster is a former Master of Kamar-Taj who follows Kaecilius into the Zealots. He helps steal the ritual from the Book of Cagliostro and dies fighting Stephen Strange at the New York Sanctum.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A former Master who follows Kaecilius into the Zealots.

proposed.text: Lucian is a former Master of Kamar-Taj who follows Kaecilius into the Zealots. He helps steal the ritual from the Book of Cagliostro and dies fighting Stephen Strange at the New York Sanctum.

changes.evidence: The surname 'Aster' is never said or shown in Doctor Strange; fandom sources it to the Marvel Studios Visual Dictionary (tie-in), and his on-screen designation is 'Strong Zealot'. Only the surname is removed.

now.title: Doctor Strange
now.text: The Ancient One takes Stephen Strange in at Kamar-Taj after the accident that ruins his hands and teaches him the mystic arts, knowing he is meant to succeed her. Before she dies, she tells him that sometimes the rules have to be broken for the greater good.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Strange's teacher. Trains him in the mystic arts at Kamar-Taj.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Ancient One's student and chosen successor, trained at Kamar-Taj.

proposed.text: The Ancient One takes Stephen Strange in at Kamar-Taj after the accident that ruins his hands and teaches him the mystic arts. Before she dies, she tells him that sometimes the rules have to be broken for the greater good.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Ancient One's student, trained at Kamar-Taj.

changes.evidence: In Doctor Strange the Ancient One says she has only been able to see the possibilities of his future; the claim that she knew he would become her successor is sourced by fandom to Avengers: Endgame (a later title), not to this film.

now.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
now.text: Wanda lays siege to Kamar-Taj while hunting America Chavez and knocks Wong aside. She captures him and forces him to lead her to Mount Wundagore, where he reveals the Darkhold's origins to spare the other sorcerers.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer Wanda captures to lead her to Mount Wundagore.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The witch who captures Wong and forces him to Mount Wundagore.

proposed.text: Wanda lays siege to Kamar-Taj while hunting America Chavez and knocks Wong aside. When she threatens the surviving sorcerers, he reveals that the Darkhold is a copy of spells carved on Mount Wundagore, and she forces him to lead her there.

changes.evidence: Wong reveals the Darkhold's origins at Kamar-Taj, after Sara destroys the book and Wanda threatens Rintrah and the wounded sorcerers; only then does he take her to Mount Wundagore (Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness).

now.title: Eternals
now.text: Ajak is the only Eternal who speaks with Arishem, the Celestial who created them. She turns against his plan once she learns it will destroy Earth.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The Celestial who created the Eternals. Ajak turns against his plan.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The only Eternal who speaks with Arishem. She turns against his plan.

proposed.text: Ajak is the only Eternal who speaks with Arishem, the Celestial who created them, and she has always known his plan will destroy Earth. Moved by the Avengers undoing the Blip, she turns against it at last.

changes.evidence: Ajak knew the Emergence would destroy Earth from the start (Arishem tells Sersi she has helped many Celestials emerge; she voiced this concern in Babylon and told Ikaris the truth centuries ago). She first doubts Arishem after the Blip is undone, then tells Ikaris they must stop it (Eternals).

now.title: Echo

now.on_a_card_about_b: Biscuits's cousin, whom he helps after she comes home.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Maya's cousin, who keeps her return to Tamaha a secret.

changes.evidence: Biscuits does not help out at Skully's pawn shop: in Echo#2 he goes there as a customer to buy items on Maya's list (Skully even signs for him to leave). In Echo#1 he finds Maya squatting at the Battiest house and she has him keep her return between them.
